_doc: Performance gate (ADR 017). bench/run.sh perf <base-ref> runs these suites interleaved at the base and here, COUNT times each, and bench/perfgate fails on a statistically significant regression (benchstat, p < alpha) beyond the budget. A budget other than the default needs an ADR, named in its entry.

suites._doc: sub-millisecond: at 20x a round was ~10 ms and one GC or background task doubled it (bimodal on 4 CPUs; PR #16 failed identical code)
